name: Manga Translate - RTX 5090 reusable
cmd: set -e; umask 077; mkdir -p /workspace/manga-runtime/ssh /workspace/manga-runtime/logs; if [ ! -s /workspace/manga-runtime/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key ]; then ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -f /workspace/manga-runtime/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key; fi; cp /workspace/manga-runtime/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key; cp /workspace/manga-runtime/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub; chmod 600 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key; chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub; if [ -f /workspace/manga-translate-v2/deployment/runpod/manage.py ]; then /usr/bin/python3 /workspace/manga-translate-v2/deployment/runpod/manage.py start >> /workspace/manga-runtime/logs/boot.log 2>&1 & fi; exec /start.sh
